// diagnostic

E1101

`{value}` cannot cross the `{boundary}` boundary: the value writes shared state

What

`{value}` cannot cross the `{boundary}` boundary: the value writes shared state

Why

The `{boundary}` boundary can run concurrently with its owner; {reason}

Fix

Give it with `^`, freeze it with `freeze`, or share it with `shared`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1101: tests/ui/crossing_shared_write_voice.stderr.

Error [E0101]: this program has no `run` function
 Why: running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one
 Fix: add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0101

Error [E1101]: `count` cannot cross the `task capture` boundary: the value writes shared state
  --> tests/ui/crossing_shared_write_voice.jet:3:10
    |
  3 |     task {
    |          ^
 Why: the `task capture` boundary can run concurrently with its owner; the write would race with the owner or require a hidden merge rule
 Fix: give it with `^`, freeze it with `freeze`, or share it with `shared`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1101
